Title: Experimental trophic flexibility guides a compartmentalized genome-scale model of red microalgae Galdieria sulphuraria
Summary: Integrates cultivation data with an organelle-resolved genome-scale metabolic model of Galdieria sulphuraria that describes autotrophic, mixotrophic, and heterotrophic metabolism.

Title: Synthetic Biology Tools and Strategies for Microbial Cell Factory Construction
Summary: Reviews synthetic biology tools and strategies for microbial cell-factory construction, including DBTL cycles, metabolic pathway design, enzyme engineering, flux balancing, and dynamic regulation.

Title: A general deep learning method based on substrate information for genome-scale mining of natural product biosynthetic enzymes
Summary: Presents a deep-learning framework that uses substrate information for genome-scale mining of natural product biosynthetic enzymes to support heterologous expression.

Title: Replacing anaerobic fermentation with reverse β-oxidation enables growth-coupled evolution for enhanced fatty-alcohol production
Summary: Replaces mixed-acid fermentation in Escherichia coli with a redox-balanced reverse β-oxidation pathway that couples anaerobic growth to medium-chain fatty-alcohol production and enables adaptive evolution.

Title: Orchestrating polyketide synthase-derived aldehyde metabolism for Streptomyces biomanufacturing
Summary: Orchestrates polyketide synthase-derived aldehyde release and downstream metabolism in Streptomyces for biomanufacturing of aldehyde-pathway products.

Title: Multilevel Metabolic Engineering of Cupriavidus necator for CO2-Derived Single-Cell Protein Production
Summary: Applies multilevel metabolic engineering in Cupriavidus necator to improve nitrogen assimilation and carbon-energy coordination for single-cell protein from CO2.

Title: A Synthetic Promoter Library Spanning a Wide Dynamic Range for Metabolic Pathway Engineering in Zymomonas mobilis
Summary: Builds a synthetic promoter library spanning a wide dynamic range, with strong terminators, for multi-enzyme pathway engineering in Zymomonas mobilis.

Title: Developing the Escherichia coli Platform for Efficient Glycosylation of Steviol Glycosides through Metabolic Engineering
Summary: Metabolically engineers Escherichia coli as a platform for efficient glycosylation of rare steviol glycosides that are scarce in the native plant.

Title: Metabolic Engineering Strategies for Rare d-Allulose Production from d-Glucose–d-Xylose Mixtures Using Escherichia coli
Summary: Develops metabolic engineering strategies in Escherichia coli for rare d-allulose production from mixed d-glucose–d-xylose substrates rather than single-sugar feeds.

Title: Systematic small regulatory RNA guided pathway attenuation enables high-level riboflavin production in Escherichia coli
Summary: Uses systematic small-regulatory-RNA pathway attenuation to raise riboflavin production in Escherichia coli.

Title: Metabolic engineering of Methylorubrum extorquens PA1 for cinnamic acid production from ethanol
Summary: Engineers Methylorubrum extorquens PA1 to convert ethanol into cinnamic acid as a carbon-recycling cell factory.

Title: Highly selective ethanol production via the thermophilic bioconversion of sugars and syngas using metabolically engineered Neomoorella thermoacetica
Summary: Metabolically engineers Neomoorella thermoacetica for highly selective ethanol production from sugars and syngas using a redox-guided design.

Title: Metabolic Engineering of Saccharomyces cerevisiae for Flavonoid Synthesis from Acetate
Summary: Engineers Saccharomyces cerevisiae for flavonoid synthesis from acetate, using adaptive laboratory evolution to overcome poor growth and metabolic compatibility on this C2 feedstock.
